column1: # Class Tree 在 / 跟 / 给 / 从 / 用 cloze. English is the prompt; □ hides the preposition.
# Pattern: Subject + prep + noun + verb. Counts: 在 6, 跟 5, 给 5, 从 4, 用 4. File order is shuffled.
# Not the same 跟 sentences as Connectors. 在 is location (not progressive). 给 is for someone (not give).
